item.title: 🔴 Palo Alto GlobalProtect VPN auth bypass flaw now exploited in attacks
item.description:
Why this matters: Potential data exposure — check monitoring and incident response readiness.
Palo Alto Networks is warning that hackers are now exploiting a PAN-OS GlobalProtect authentication bypass flaw, tracked as CVE-2026-0257, in attacks attempting to breach corporate networks. [...]

Source: BleepingComputer  |  Severity: Critical  |  Age: 5h ago

item.title: 🟠 New CIFSwitch Linux flaw gives root on multiple distributions
item.description:
Why this matters: Privilege escalation risk — review local admin exposure and endpoint controls.
A newly discovered local privilege escalation vulnerability dubbed 'CIFSwitch' in the Linux kernel could allow attackers to forge CIFS authentication key descriptions, abuse the kernel's key request mechanism, and gain root privileges. [...]

Source: BleepingComputer  |  Severity: Important  |  Age: 8h ago
